item.title: Storyline
item.content:encoded:
Yeah, it's cool that SCP-507 randomly travels to different dimensions, but maybe we should follow a story. I would like some shifts that guide our "hero" trough a cool lore or revisit some characters besides of Smiling Man.

My proposal for story would be that SCP-507 would met the woman of 99P-UT1-24J at some point. Let's call her J-1 (for now)

J-1 was left alone in that paradise world. Unfortunately no one else would come to that world, so she looked for ways to move between alternative worlds to find SCP-507. She found a way, but every time she tries to shift at will, it will be a random shift. Eventually, she found him, but it wasn't her SCP-507: this SCP-507 had never meet her. Even so she found multiple SCP-507, several times, but none of those were her version: only his 507 had been in his world, only he would know her, no other knows about her

Following the line between dimensions and falling in random places just as it happened to his love, apparently she was unique, because she never saw or heard anyone talk about a being like her. After several attempts, J-1 thought of delivering a letter to the SCP-507 duplicates she found, a letter that they also should deliver to other SCP-507 hoping to find her love. Many 507 refused the task, others accepted but when they shifted back they could not keep the letter, others kept the letter but did not remember to communicate it to another SCP-507, so only a few sent the message. But that was enough.

In an interaction between SCP-507-B and SCP-507-A, 507-B was able to deliver the message to 507-A. He reacted in amazement: she existed, she was still there. She was looking for him. That filled the heart of 507-B, the original, with hope and warmth

Yeah, i know, its a little bit rough, but it is just an example.

item.content:encoded:
Added a new entry. Might add more in the future.

If anybody wants me to whittle the entry down, I'll do so.

+  **RRA-1944-20X0**
-  **RRA-1944-20X0**

Retrieval: Via tracking device. Subject was found inside an abandoned house in Unalaska, Alaska, sitting in a chair so as to have its knees against its chest. Subject was wearing a full military uniform with unknown symbols that appear to indicate rank. Subject had "S-CLASS 507" stitched into the uniform above its breast pocket. Subject's face was "caked in mud", and appeared to be suffering from a severe concussion as well shell shock.

Subject shifted in while asleep. Awoke to the sound of mortar bombardment hitting underground bunker it had shifted into. Subject had already been stripped of gear. Subject says a man bearing the description of Agent ███████ entered the bunker, and "ordered [subject] to get [its] lazy [EXPLETIVE] into [its] uniform" and that "he [the Agent] had been waiting long enough" for the Subject to reappear. Agent ███████ then proceeded to give Subject a camera to "record the combat" before leaving the building. Subject claims that his memory was a bit foggy, but stated that he had shifted into a dimension were World War II was still being fought fiercely and that the year was apparently 1986. The SCP Foundation existed as the "Specialized Anomalous Combat of the United States Army" (SAC-USA), and it seemed that anomalous entities of various sorts were being used. (See "Notable Entity Involvement"). The war had boiled down to a three-way fight between Germany, the United States, and the Soviet Union; all other counties had either been "absorbed" by the other factions, or destroyed outright. Subject was partaking in the Seventh Battle of France, with the US fighting off "the third consecutive Russian invasion". Apparetnly, midway through the battle, ther Germans showed up and also started attacking. Subject suffered a severe concussion from mortar fire prior to shifting back.

It is estimated Subject was in dimension 20X0 for approximately 15 days.

While 507 was unable to provide vivid descriptions on a large amount of the activities he had preformed, the camera he was provided had shifted along with him. After the film was developed, several pictures were shown to have a presence of one or more SCP. The SCPs shown in photographs or mentioned by 507 are listed below.

SCP Designation - Notes

  • SCP-173: Used by SAC-USA. Subject stated that it was equipped with a metal helmet and "was flying along the ground, regardless of how many people were looking at it, snapping necks everywhere it went". Subject also noted 173 appeared to have a chunk of its left shoulder missing.
  • SCP-682: Photographed. Image shows 682 in mid flight, appearing to have been launched out of a heavily modified Sherman tank, complete with an barrel large enough to fire 682. Gun is aimed at a heavily defended church; it is unclear which faction has taken refuge in the church.
  • SCP-2006: [DATA EXPUNGED]. It is unclear which faction 2006 was allied with.
  • SCP-049: Photographed. Shown inside a building treating wounded soldiers. According to 507, "[049] was the best medic in the entire platoon. If he couldn't fix your injury, then you were considered a lost cause." It is unclear if the 049 in this universe uses the same methods as the 049 in our universe.
  • SCP-096 Photographed. Single, blurred image of 096 brutally murdering an unidentifiable troop (likely German). 096 has back to camera. 507 claims that 096 showed up "in the middle of a fight" and was murdering "literally everyone". It is strongly believed that 096 was not under containment by any faction.
  • SCP-963: 507 apparently managed to recover several documents that indicated that there were no less than 4 instances of SCP-963 in this dimension. 963-1 apparently contains Dr. Jack Bright, who apparently is still a researcher at Site-05 (it should be noted that Site-05, in fact, does exist in this dimension); 963-2 contains George S. Patton Jr.; 963-3 apparently contains Adolf Hitler; the "contents" of 963-4 are unknown. A recovered document also indicate that Patton apparently now constantly fights on the front lines and has been "killed" at least 37 times, and that Adolf Hitler has been "killed" or assassinated no less than 18 times.
  • SCP-106: Subject suggests that there was no less than three (3) instances of SCP-106 on the battlefield. Subject stated that while it was clear that one of them was fighting for SAC-USA, it is unclear which faction the other two were on (assuming they were a part of any faction).
  • SCP-035: Photographed. Photograph shows a decayed corpse of a German wearing SCP-035 in the distance. 035 appears to be in middle of brutally murdering a soldier of the Soviet Union. 507 believes that 035 was being used by the Germans.
  • SCP-053: Photographed. 507 reported "a little girl" that appeared to be around the age of three or four years old. Subject claims that "she was walking like it was a normal day, and completely ignoring all the destruction around her". Subject reported that anyone who came within approximately 2 meters of the girl would "drop dead on the spot for seemingly now reason". The same photograph that captured 2006 also captured the little girl, which analysis confirming that it is almost certainly SCP-053.
  • Notable Retrieved Items: One (1) camera of unknown make/model; two (2) fragmentation grenades (appear to be modified Mk. II grenades); one heavily modified M1 Garand capable of firing 50 cal. rounds; twelve (12) spare "en bloc" magazines (heavily redesigned to fit six (6) 50 cal. rounds); one (1) makeshift combat knife made of an unknown metal. (For a full list, please see document "RRA-1944-20X0-Recovered Materials")
  • Requests: A long hot shower [Granted], a resupply of equipment [Granted], fresh clothes [Granted] and being allowed to keep the gun [Denied; currently held in storage]
